nodes.summary: It accepts a bitstring $x$ exactly when $x$ decodes, under the canonical bitstring encoding, to a triple $(n, C, K)$ of a natural number $n$, a list $C$ of lists of natural numbers (the tests) and a natural number $K$ with the following properties: every test is a list of numbers below $n$ without repeated entries, and some sublist $T$ of $C$, obtained by deleting entries of $C$, has length at most $K$ and…
nodes.title: The MINIMUM TEST SET decision problem

nodes.summary: An instance $(n, C, K)$ of MINIMUM TEST SET is feasible when some sublist $T$ of $C$ (obtained by deleting entries of $C$) has length at most $K$ and distinguishes every pair: for all distinct $a, b < n$ some test in $T$ contains exactly one of $a$ and $b$.
nodes.title: Feasible minimum test set instance

nodes.summary: An instance of MINIMUM TEST SET is a triple $(n, C, K)$ of a natural number $n$ (the number of elements), a finite list $C$ of finite lists of natural numbers (the tests) and a natural number $K$ (the bound).
nodes.title: Minimum test set instance

nodes.summary: The MINIMUM TEST SET decision problem lies in NP, and every decision problem in NP has a polynomial-time many-one reduction to it.
nodes.title: MINIMUM TEST SET is NP-complete

nodes.summary: An instance $(n, C, K)$ of MINIMUM TEST SET is well formed when every test in the list $C$ is a list of numbers below $n$ without repeated entries, so that each test lists a subset of $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$, each element once.
nodes.title: Well-formed minimum test set instance

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
